note: Numbers of the reference run of notebooks/Olist_Complete_Project.ipynb (a re-run on Kaggle can differ in the 2nd-3rd decimal).

delivery.title: Step 1 - delivery days per order (test = last 20 % of purchase time)
extra: Late-risk AUC 0.805 vs 0.799 for the marketplace estimate; alert threshold 0.15 -> precision 13.8 %, recall 72 %.
Promise at equal on-time rate: 18.0 days vs 21.4 days of the marketplace (94.3 % vs 94.7 % on time).
R2 ceiling: ~0.28 with order-time information, ~0.44 if the carrier hand-over time is known. The rest is noise the data does not contain.

demand.title: Step 2 - weekly units per category (test = 16 weeks, 320 category-weeks)
extra: R2 0.79 (95 % CI 0.75-0.82) but the naive forecast already has 0.73: the real gain is ~8 % lower MAE.
Reorder level q90 covered 91.6 % of the test weeks (target 90 %).
Olist has no stock-level data: the output is a demand forecast and a reorder point, not a measured saving.
